confirmation: wsq; previously unused author; hash-character training/test groups
candidate_policy: same original top 16 compatible whole-source components as D
placement_policy: same positive shared scale and translation as D; never deform tips
penalty: equal-stroke mean of 1 minus cosine similarity; undefined directions abstain
selection_rule: among variants with geometry mean no more than 1% above D and activation count equal to D, minimize mean terminal angle error; then geometry, weight, reference; if no improvement over D keep D
confirmation_order: round robin by component context using existing raw-transform-v1 character hashes
evaluation_unit: character; average target component stroke metrics within each character
confirmation_rule: report A/D/frozen E on the same targets, with coverage/fallback/geometry/terminal direction/arc length; no tuning or default promotion based on confirmation
data_policy: same character repeats stay together; target captures used only after all selection is finished
limitations: exploratory development, one new author, descriptive paired results; no significance claim
